title: First 2s displacement
description: Essential: Correctly calculates +5 m (east) + (-3 m) (west) = +2 m or 2 m east.

title: First 4s displacement
description: Essential: Correctly calculates +5 + (-3) + (-4) + (+1) = -1 m or 1 m west.

title: Last 2s displacement
description: Essential: Correctly calculates displacement from t=2s to t=4s as (-4 m) + (+1 m) = -3 m or 3 m west.

title: Vector sum reasoning
description: Important: Applies displacement as the vector sum of individual 1-second displacements.

title: Direction specification
description: Important: States direction (east/west) or sign convention consistently with numerical answers.

title: Sign convention error
description: Pitfall: Uses distances instead of signed displacements, or confuses east/west signs.

title: Time interval confusion
description: Pitfall: For last 2 seconds, incorrectly uses first 2 seconds or full 4-second displacement.
